minimumLikes.description: Save only content with at least this many likes. Use 0 to disable the filter.

minimumComments.description: Save only content with at least this many comments. Use 0 to disable the filter.

minimumViews.description: Save only Reels or videos with at least this many reported plays. Non-video posts are excluded when this value is above 0.

strictBooleanSyntax.description: Reject implicit expressions such as 'bank NOT jobs'. Leave disabled to normalize them to 'bank AND NOT jobs' with a warning.
